text:
jess: Heads up — PR #75421 is ready for review. This touches kv-prefetch/cache TTL and embeddings-cache routing fallback. Need runtime + platform + infra + security eyes and someone to steward the canary. Quick summary: switch TTL from per-shard to global heuristic, add fallback route to small-embed model when cache miss rate spikes, and expose embeddings_cache.route_fallback.count metric. PR: https://git.redwood/pulls/75421

sam: runtime — I can pick up the kernel/runtime changes and run perf baseline. Which sequences and QPS should I use?

jess: @sam ty! target workload: QPS 50, seq len 256 typical. Perf script: `./scripts/bench_kv.sh --qps 50 --seq 256`

sam: got it. I'll run on a g4dn-equivalent and post flame/alloc numbers. Expect numbers by EOD.

maria: platform — I can own the canary schedule + observability flags. @alec can you be canary steward? Need dashboards updated for `embeddings_cache.hit_rate` and `embeddings_cache.route_fallback.count`.

alec: I can steward Mon 10–12 PST. Proposed rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 1h gaps, auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.5% or p99 latency increases > 20%.

kevin: infra — quick ask: does this change us using more pinned memory or mmap? I need peak resident memory and alloc churn from the perf run to sign off capacity. Also share expected OOM scenarios so we can adjust node pool if needed.

jess: short perf excerpt from local run (dev env):
```
alloc_peak_rss: 6.1GB
alloc_churn_1m: 120MB
cache_miss_rate: 0.07
route_fallback.count: 12
```
No new mmap/pinned flags in this change.

lee: security — quick Q: does this introduce any new KMS calls or change auth header ordering for routed requests? If yes, need a short threat model + confirm nothing leaks to logs. If no, we can do a light review but still want the runbook and rollback steps.

jess: No new KMS usage. Auth headers unchanged. Runbook added to the PR with rollback commands and alert thresholds.

pr-bot: PR #75421 requested reviewers: @sam @maria @kevin @lee @alec

sam: I'll post full perf CSV and flame graphs by 5pm PT.

maria: sounds good — I'll sketch the canary dashboard and add the grafana panels. :thumbsup:

kevin: once we have perf CSV I'll run a quick capacity calc and post node-sizing recs.

lee: I'll do a security pass once the runbook + PR notes are updated (especially confirm no secret logging).

jess: thanks all — I'll ping again after sam's numbers. Appreciate quick eyes on this one, small change but sensitive for latency and memory.
